author: TwoBytes
tagline: French app: search, browse and send downloads from plugin-based sources.
description:
Agora is a French self-hosted web app: its interface is in French and its official plugins target French-language sources. It searches several sources at once through signed plugins, shows the results with TMDB metadata, and hands the links to JDownloader or pyLoad-ng.

- French interface (no other language for now)
- Plugin marketplace with Ed25519-signed plugins
- Multi-user accounts with an admin role
- First-run setup wizard: create the admin account, pick plugins, configure
- Works over plain HTTP on your LAN; HTTPS is optional behind a reverse proxy

tips.before_install: On first launch, open the web UI and follow the setup wizard to create the admin account.

title: Agora
release_note: Agora 2.0.2: links protected by a Cloudflare captcha (Loadix first) can be fetched from Agora, you solve the captcha yourself and a browser script sends the link back to JDownloader, pyLoad or the direct link window.
